summary: A labeled text input: the field frame every field shares (label, hint, description, control, help, fallback, the issue mark) around a one-line input or a growing text area. A problem is said by a mark at the control's end, so a form never changes height.

anatomy.label: Names the control; a press on it focuses the control.
anatomy.requiredStar: A star after the label, said as the word to a screen reader (requiredMark star).
anatomy.requiredWord: The word after the label and outside it (requiredMark word).
anatomy.hint: A short note beside the label: a unit, a format, a default; in the code face when it is a key.
anatomy.note: A part beside the label after the hint: a badge, a link to the docs.
anatomy.description: A sentence between the label and the control: what the question asks.
anatomy.control: The input or text area: ground, edge, corners, value, placeholder.
anatomy.issueMark: A button inside the control's end, shown only with an issue, in the worst issue's ink.
anatomy.issuePopover: Opens from the mark: each issue's text, its detail, and the actions that put it right.
anatomy.help: A sentence under the control: what a right answer looks like.
anatomy.fallback: A line under the help: what applies when the field is left empty.

keyHint.does: The hint is a setting's key: drawn in the code face, never translated.

fallback.does: Under the help: what applies when empty.

error.does: One critical issue: the value is refused.

issues.does: Several issues, each { tone: critical | warning, text, detail?, actions? }. A warning is allowed; a critical one stops the submit.

issueOpen.does: Whether the mark's popover is open, held from outside so a form's issue count can open it.

mono.does: The value in the code face, for keys and addresses; spell checking off.

monoLabel.does: The label in the code face too.

multiline.does: A text area that grows with its text up to maxRows lines, then scrolls.

rows.does: A text area's height in lines.

maxRows.does: The most lines a text area grows to.

placeholder.does: An example in the empty control; never instead of a label.

readOnly.does: Shows the value; cannot be changed.

inRow.does: In a row of fields: shares four rows (label, description, control, help) with the fields beside it so their controls stand level.
inRow.context: Field inside Columns with fields (FieldRows context, CSS subgrid)

default.note: density.control: 32 regular, 28 compact. Below 768 the text is 16px so a phone does not zoom the page on focus.

multiline.note: At least 112 tall (min-h-28), growing with its text; with maxRows, between rows and maxRows lines plus 18 (padding and edge).

labelToControl.note: The gap between the label row, the description, the control and the help.

issueRoom.note: The control's end padding while an issue shows, so the value never runs under the mark.

issueMark.note: Square at control-sm (28 regular, 24 compact), 4 from the control's end, centered on its height; icon 16.

issuePopoverWidth.note: min(320, window width - 32); opens below the mark, aligned to its end, 6 away; padding 12, 12 between issues.

rest.means: Empty with its placeholder, or holding a value.

hover.means: The pointer is over it. No look of its own today.

focus.means: The control has focus. A browser shows a text input's focus however it came, so this is any focus.

pressed.means: A press focuses it; no look of its own.

readOnly.means: Shows a value that cannot be changed here. No look of its own today; focusable and selectable.

invalid.means: The worst issue is critical: the value is refused and the submit stops. The edge alone at rest, no ring.

invalid+focus.means: An invalid control with focus: the critical edge and a 3px ring. The ring shows only with focus, never at rest.
invalid+focus.sokkel-ui: The primitive draws aria-invalid:focus-visible:ring-invalid ring-invalid-ring, the ring only on focus, as ISSUE_EDGE states; src/rules.test.ts fails a ring drawn at rest.

warning.means: The worst issue is a warning: allowed, but worth a look.
warning.sokkel-ui: Field's warning tone; IssueMark in warning-ink; not aria-invalid

warning+focus.means: A control with a warning, focused: the warning edge and a 1px ring.
warning+focus.reached: focus on a control with a warning

issueOpen.reached: a press on the mark, Enter or Space on it, or issueOpen

busy.means: The app is working on the value (an add, a save): the text is held read only with a spinner at the control's end, focus kept.
busy.sokkel-ui: Not in TextField. QuickAdd and the inline edit cycle (lib/edit) draw it today.

rest.note: keyHint: the code face in muted-foreground.
Drawn only with an issue; in warning-ink when the worst is a warning.
Each issue: its icon in the tone's ink, its text 15/20 at 500, its detail in text.help, its actions as underlined text.help links.

keyboard.does: Focuses the control; the next Tab reaches the issue mark when there is one.
Calls onEnter, such as to submit or add.
Calls onEscape, such as to drop an edit.
Closes the issue popover; focus stays where it was.
Focuses the control, also one a label does not focus by itself (an editor drawn as text).

appText.label: Required.
appText.placeholder: Optional: an example, never the label.
appText.error: The refusal, in the app's or the server's words.
appText.issues: Each issue's text, detail and action labels.

sokkel-ui: The issue popover is Base UI's Popover; the mark's accessible name is every issue said as one sentence.
describedBy() points the control at its description, help and fallback; an issue speaks from its mark.
A row of fields lines up through CSS subgrid (Columns with fields).
sokkel-ui-egui: TextEdit has no frame of its own here: the widget draws the frame and sets the inner margin so the text is centered in the control height.
The phone text size (16px below 768) is a browser zoom guard; a native renderer may keep text.body.
Lining fields up in a row needs the row to measure every field's label and description first (two passes, or a Grid).

drift.spec: An issue mark at the control's end with a popover; nothing is inserted under the field.
drift.today: The error is a line under the field in critical-ink, in place of the help, so the form changes height.

drift.spec: Fills the room it is given.
hint, keyHint, description, fallback, required marks, warning tone, issue actions, multiline, mono, numeric, readOnly, phone sizes.
